question: **Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Artefect'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word among the given options is **"Artefect."**
 
• The **correct spelling** is "Artifact" or "Artefact.:* An object* made by a human being, typically an item of cultural or historical interest.(कृत्रिम वस्तु, पुरातत्विक वस्तु)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Artefect'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arduous:** Involving or requiring strenuous effort; difficult and tiring.(कठिन)
 
• **Arrogate: ** Take or claim (something) without justification.(अनधिकार प्राप्ति)
 
• **Articulate:** Having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently.(स्पष्ट, योग्यता से बोलने वाला)
